description: PROP-Q5 (required:true) is not actually enforced. Spec REQ-Q5 says 'THE SYSTEM SHALL write ~/loops/<slot>/.dormant.sentinel'. The implementation only exposes is_dormant(neg_7day_windows, age_days) -> bool. No code path writes the sentinel file. Test test_dormant_at_14_consecutive_negative_windows only checks the boolean predicate; it never verifies file creation. The 'graceful disable' side-effect that defines REQ-Q5 is missing entirely from disk. A consumer calling is_dormant() must implement the sentinel write itself, which sprint-2 does not provide.
